auth_rule: Public register/login/forgot/reset; refresh authenticates cookie, all /api/me/* and activation except production early guard require valid access session. JWT signed server key reference, exp15min, sub=user_id, sid=session id; API validates signature/issuer/audience/expiry and sessions revoked_at/expiry on each private request. Password Argon2id proposed m=65536KiB,t=3,p=1 with library defaults for random salt; library pin pending. Email trimmed/lowercase unique. Refresh random32bytes, SHA256 hash only DB, cookie HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax Path=/api/auth MaxAge7days; rotation locks session, revokes old and issues new same family; reuse revokes family, logout family, reset all sessions. Dev localhost HTTPS setup required before enabling secure-cookie flow; no weakened production config. Cookie-auth refresh additionally rejects Origin other than configured same origin; FE sends credentials, token stays in memory, no localStorage. Forgot-password always202 generic, random32bytes base64url reset email Mailpit(dev), hash DB,1h expiry,single-use; reset atomically consumes token/changes password/revokes sessions. Never log tokens. Proposed rate limits:5 failed logins/IP/15min,3 reset requests/IP/hour ->429. Registration DOB civil date America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires must compute age>=18; DOB private self-declaration, no stronger identity claim. Profile phone libphonenumber-js full metadata parses AR international E.164, isValid AND getType=MOBILE, fixed or FIXED_LINE_OR_MOBILE/unknown422; FE applies same library/metadata rule, server authoritative. This validates classification, not possession or WhatsApp account. Description plain text, escape rendering, never dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Public DTO permits intentional WhatsApp contact link only; exclude email,DOB,hashes,sessions,owner IDs and billing details. Ownership selected through sessions, no client user_id. Nonowned photo404; expired plan does not disable authenticated profile management.
